candidates.titulo: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
candidates.resumen:
ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified "Business Agents" that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping. The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta.

candidates.titulo: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
candidates.resumen: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
candidates.resumen: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

candidates.titulo: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
candidates.resumen:
Google is rolling out its latest AI model, Gemini 4 Carbon, to the general public after releasing it to a select group of "cybersecurity defenders" two weeks ago. Google claims Carbon is its "strongest model" yet, and capable of competing with the very best systems from Anthropic and OpenAI.

candidates.titulo: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
candidates.resumen: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

candidates.titulo: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
candidates.resumen: Adobe is committing itself to the notion that chatbots and AI agents could be your next design assistant, or even automate creative workflows and repetitive tasks on your behalf. candidates.resumen: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.
